['BP Europa SE '].company_description: BP Europa SE is a European joint-stock company of the BP group. It was established in 2010 through the merger of BP companies in Belgium, the Netherlands, Austria, and Poland with the German Deutsche BP AG. The company is registered in Hamburg, Germany, with its administrative headquarters located in Bochum. BP Europa SE is primarily engaged in the sale of fuels and operates in the energy sector. It is a part of BP's efforts in the green hydrogen production value chain, including conversion into derivatives like ammonia and transport. BP Europa SE also collaborates with Lekkerland SE to deliver REWE To Go stores at Aral retail sites in Germany.

['ZF Friedrichshafen AG '].company_description: ZF Friedrichshafen AG, also known as ZF Group, is a global technology company specializing in engineering, research and development, and manufacturing activities in the automotive industry. It supplies systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial technology. ZF Friedrichshafen offers driveline and chassis technology for cars and commercial vehicles, as well as specialist plant equipment such as construction equipment. It is also involved in the rail, marine, defense, and aviation industries, as well as general industrial applications. The company has 168 production locations in 32 countries and employs approximately 165,000 people.
